_about: Weights for the offline rules engine (rules_agent.decide). Risk points come from red/amber signals, trust points from green ones. Deterministic red signals skip the arithmetic and always give likely_scam. Tactic signal ids come from tactics.json. Tune against `scamcheck eval --mode baseline` on both evals/dataset.jsonl and evals/challenge.jsonl; every change should be justified by the evals, not by a single example.

thresholds._note: net = risk - trust. net >= likely_scam_net_risk -> likely_scam (medium); net >= suspicious_net_risk -> suspicious (medium). Risk below min_risk_to_warn with nothing verified -> insufficient_information. Any red signal plus strong pressure language -> likely_scam (medium).
